fields.name: company name
fields.status: active or inactive (no filings for over a year: delisted, acquired or bankrupt)
fields.filed: filing date of the 10-K behind the scores (the date the data became public)
fields.bankruptcy_risk: calibrated probability of a bankruptcy filing within 2 years (0-1)
fields.bankruptcy_percentile: share of 10-Ks filed in the previous 365 days with a lower risk (0-1)
fields.restatement_risk: calibrated probability of a restatement notice (8-K Item 4.02) within 2 years (0-1)
fields.restatement_percentile: share of 10-Ks filed in the previous 365 days with a lower restatement risk (0-1)
fields.altman_z: Altman Z-Score (1968); below 1.8 distress, above 3 safe
fields.beneish_m: Beneish M-Score; above -1.78 flags possible earnings manipulation
fields.latest_10q: latest 10-Q update: filing date, bankruptcy risk and percentile among 10-Qs of the previous 365 days

source: SEC EDGAR (XBRL company facts, filing index)
